scope.purpose: Define proof/readiness gates required before any later Layer 3 workbench execution implementation is selected.

authority_order: GitHub PR state for merged/open status
current main repo truth for live implementation surfaces
Layer3 planning docs for branch-local freeze scope
mockup spec for target-state product intent only

readiness_gates.decision: Proof claims must be machine-readable and cite exact files, commands, and expected results.
Every workbench state must declare authority source, allowed next actions, and forbidden downstream posture.
Canonical preview hash basis must be frozen before approval/revision/execution can depend on it.
Every state-writing endpoint must define duplicate and retry behavior before execution.
Approval, revision, and future execution transitions must be serialized by server authority, not browser state.
The return path from plan_revision_requested to an approvable preview must be explicitly frozen.
Approved-plan cancellation or supersession must be explicitly frozen or remain unavailable.
Datum/fact/finding/insight/caveat/result/package terms must be defined or deferred before results UI.
RAG/vector/upload/local-directory/qualitative/hybrid scope must be explicitly admitted or remain unavailable.

validation_commands.purpose: Verify focused Layer 3 workbench backend/page behavior remains green.

browser_proof_rule: No browser proof is required for this docs-only readiness slice because runtime UI behavior does not change. A later UI or execution slice must run both headed and headless browser proof when browser behavior changes.
